title: Cross closure within a part
statement: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a monochromatic rectangle partition for a function $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$, and let $R \in \mathcal{P}$. If $(x,y)$ and $(x',y')$ both belong to $R$, then the two "crossed" pairs $(x',y)$ and $(x,y')$ also belong to $R$.
hypotheses_covered: P is a monochromatic rectangle partition for g
R is a member of P
replaced:
If $\mathcal{P}$ is a monochromatic rectangle partition for $g$, $R \in \mathcal{P}$,
and $(x,y), (x',y') \in R$, then the mixed pairs $(x',y)$ and $(x,y')$ both
belong to $R$.
